preconditions.description: The input integer k must be between 1 and 10^9.

postconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 1000.

postconditions.expression: len(G) == n and all(len(row) == n for row in G)
postconditions.description: The adjacency matrix G must have n rows and n columns.
There must be no self-loops in the graph.

postconditions.expression: all(G[i][j] == G[j][i] for i in range(n) for j in range(i+1, n))

postconditions.description: There must be at least one path between vertex 1 and vertex 2.
The number of shortest paths between vertex 1 and vertex 2 must be exactly k.
